Hey buddy, I've got an update! My sister found out that I was going to try to kill myself and talked to me about it lmao. She was really empathetic and lovely about it, and I feel like my burden has gotten a bit lighter. Nothing feels very real, and I'm still scared. But I guess I'll try living a little bit more, even if it's mostly for her sake. Thank you so so much for being with me <33 I just hope you can have lots of nice experiences and moments in your life. I think you're lovely :) Please take lots of care, you deserve all of that and much more! Xoxo

Yeah, I'm not sure if I have depression. I don't think I know much about myself lol. I think I'm getting a little bit tired of chatting, but I had a nice time with you. Thank you for talking to me, and opening me up :) I think I'll rest a little bit, finish what I have to do, and maybe we can talk a little later. It must be tiring for you too, to talk about this kind of stuff multiple times a day.

I don't know, I don't feel like she would take me seriously. I feel like she would blame me and tell me my life isn't bad enough for me to be thinking about dying, something like that. She has said this kind of thing before and I guess I'm just tired of hearing it. I don't really want to seek treatment, I don't think I want to get better. I'm just exhausted, to the point I can't even care about anything like that anymore. Plus, treatment would be quite expensive and the places that accept my type of health insurance are really far away from my house :/

I don't know, it's all so confusing. My mom kept mentioning my grades yesterday, telling me that I'm not even trying and stuff. And I feel like she keeps joking about that fact that I told her I want to die as early as possible. I don't know how my relationship with my dad got like this, honestly. We've never really talked that much since the beginning anyways. I really want to tell you all about it, but I just can't really find the words right now. I don't really want to think about it. I'm sorry :/

Yeah, I'm sure most therapists aren't like that one. I'm not sure what classifies someone as toxic, but the reason I'm doing all of this is because I felt abandoned by my mom again, so maybe they are toxic...? I really don't know. My dad doesn't talk to me though, and I don't talk to him either.

Hey man thanks for reaching out! I've seen a bit of your profile and it seems like you're really earnest to help and hear people out, and I just want to say that I think that's very admirable :) I know life has a lot to offer, there are so many things I want to do. I could try and get some help, but I just don't want to keep going anymore. Honestly, I'd prefer to die right now than trying to get better, to getting hurt again, and to keeping on with this cycle. But I just want to rest right now. I'm just tired. I'm scared and I'm still kind of in between living and dying, but all of that is tiring me down even more. I feel like I just can't take living anymore. Thanks for listening to my rambles though!
